nonisomorphism_certificate: The orientation-preserving tesseract group has 48 elements of order8; W(D4) has none.
conclusion: The two order192 groups are nonisomorphic central double covers whose central quotients are isomorphic to the tomotope automorphism group. Pass5309 gives the explicit W(D4)/Z degree-12 tomotope action.
boundary: Do not call the Hoffman W(D4) subgroup the tesseract rotational subgroup. Their equality is false even though both have order192.
